# Resolution capacity caught up

The open support backlog fell from **180 to 126 tickets** over four weeks. These synthetic rows illustrate a bounded analysis result.

```chart
type: line
title: The open backlog fell by 30%
subtitle: End-of-week open tickets, illustrative data
data:
  inline:
    - { week: "Week 1", open: 180 }
    - { week: "Week 2", open: 168 }
    - { week: "Week 3", open: 145 }
    - { week: "Week 4", open: 126 }
encoding: { x: week, y: open }
axes:
  y: { label: Open tickets }
```

```metric
value: 126
label: Open tickets at the end of Week 4
delta: -0.30
delta_label: vs Week 1
trend: down
```
